name: How do I select the right paint finish for kitchens and bathrooms versus living areas?

mainEntity.name: How do I select the right paint finish for kitchens and bathrooms versus living areas?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing paint sheen involves balancing visual appeal with durability and moisture exposure. Flat or matte finishes absorb light and hide surface imperfections on broad drywall ceilings and living room walls, but they are difficult to scrub. Eggshell and satin sheens provide a smooth finish with mild wipeability, making them ideal for high-traffic hallways, bedrooms, and family rooms. For kitchens, bathrooms, and laundry areas where moisture and frequent cleaning occur, semi-gloss or high-durability satin sheens protect against humidity, water splashes, and staining.
acceptedAnswer.description: Use satin or semi-gloss in kitchens and bathrooms for moisture and scrub resistance, and matte or eggshell in living spaces to conceal wall flaws.
